look_here_first: Tall rhizomatous streambank sedge with several long pistillate spikes below 2–3 terminal staminate spikes.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Cyperaceae/Carex: grasslike perennial sedges with sheathing leaves; Carex fruits are enclosed in a perigynium, a key structure for species-level identification.

lookalikes.differences: C. emoryi is the tall spreading wet-site species in this set. It differs from ravenfoot sedge by having distinct elongated separate spikes instead of one dense many-branched cylindrical head.
